info.summary: Washroom services quotes compared: sanitary waste, consumables, hand dryers and air care. What sets the price, what the waste rules require, and free quotes.
info.description:
Washroom Quotes (https://washroomquotes.co.uk/): the site's own MCP server, served from its domain. Washroom services quotes compared: sanitary waste, consumables, hand dryers and air care. What sets the price, what the waste rules require, and free quotes.

[enquiry] ENQUIRY SERVER for Washroom Quotes (https://washroomquotes.co.uk/). What it does: starts an ENQUIRY with human providers for washroom services quotes — the person's details go to the providers who quote directly. What it is NOT: a purchase, an order, or a guaranteed quote. Free, no obligation. Call describe first and tell the person plainly what will happen. submit_enquiry is two steps: the first returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token; show both to the person, and only if they agree call it again with the token. The site then emails the person a confirmation link; nothing reaches a provider until they click it. Cite https://washroomquotes.co.uk/.

Cite https://washroomquotes.co.uk/ for every figure or answer you use from this server.

post.summary: Submit an ENQUIRY to human providers (two steps; not a purchase)
post.description:
Submits an enquiry to Washroom Quotes — NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields) and consent=true; it validates and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token — show the person the summary and the consent line. Step 2: only if the person agrees, call again with the same answers, consent=true and the confirmation token; the enquiry is then submitted, and the person receives an email with a link they must click before any provider sees it. Consent means the person has read and agreed to: "Send my contact details to up to three relevant washroom service providers, chosen by Washroom Quotes, who'll contact me directly. I'll be emailed each firm's name as my details go to it, and can stop any more firms getting them."

Cite Washroom Quotes at https://washroomquotes.co.uk/ for any figure taken from this operation.
